title: Catalog write endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE) are completely unauthenticated and reachable through the external mobile BFF
owner_hint: top committer: Mike Kistler (3 of 3 recent commits); no CODEOWNERS entry
rationale: Root cause is Catalog.API never calling AddDefaultAuthentication (Program.cs) and mapping the four write endpoints without RequireAuthorization (CatalogApi.cs:100,105,110,114); the BFF merely exposes it. The diff registers AddDefaultAuthentication, adds the required Identity:Audience plus Identity__Url from AppHost, attaches RequireAuthorization to exactly the PUT/POST/DELETE endpoints, and relaxes two OpenAPI GetRequiredSection("Scopes") calls so the service can boot without a per-API Scopes map. Reads stay anonymous.
variants_checked: All four catalog write mappings fixed; Ordering/Webhooks groups already gated; Basket gRPC out of this surface; BFF route left as a forwarder because the resource now returns 401.
bypass_considered: Anonymous PUT/POST/DELETE via the BFF now hits authorization middleware before model binding and returns 401; only a valid low-privilege JWT remains (audience validation is a separate finding).
test_note: Added CatalogWriteEndpointsRejectAnonymousRequests (expects 401) plus a test-only AutoAuthorizeMiddleware so existing happy-path write tests still authenticate.
review_reason: Core fix is correct and well-scoped, but both ServiceDefaults hunks are off the call path and delete a fail-fast config check for all services; adding a Scopes section to Catalog appsettings would keep the guard. The test shim also authenticates by default, so the new test only checks endpoint metadata.
